patterns.note: Alternating full-width content sections with distinct background colors (dark charcoal and creamy off-white) create clear visual breaks and guide the user vertically through the narrative.

A dramatic typographic hierarchy contrasts an oversized, highly decorative display font for key brand messages and historical dates with a classic, elegant serif for section headings and a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and labels.
A sophisticated, limited palette of deep charcoal, creamy off-white, and a rich, muted gold/amber is used consistently across backgrounds, text, and accent elements to convey luxury and heritage.

Content sections and individual elements within them reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling. A large, stylized numerical graphic ('1913') appears as a fixed, semi-transparent background element that reveals behind scrolling content.
Product display sections feature a clean, balanced grid layout that prominently showcases bottle imagery alongside concise, elegant descriptive text, maintaining a premium aesthetic.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-triggered animation system, likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger in conjunction with a smooth scrolling library like Locomotive Scroll. This system orchestrates the reveal of content sections and their internal elements (text, images) with a staggered fade-up or slide-up effect as they become visible in the viewport.

A large, decorative numerical element is implemented as a fixed or very slow-parallaxing background graphic that is revealed or faded into view as foreground content scrolls over it, creating a layered depth effect.
The initial hero background image utilizes a subtle parallax effect, moving at a slower rate than the foreground content to enhance the sense of depth and visual engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: A dramatic contrast between oversized, decorative display headings (~6-8x body) and elegant, legible serif headings (~2-3x body), supported by a clean, balanced sans-serif for body text and small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly square edges for images and containers, with minimal rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a premium, unhurried feel).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a large, decorative numerical graphic ('1913') as a fixed, revealing background element behind scrolling content creates a unique sense of depth and historical gravitas. This, combined with the dramatic contrast between a highly ornate display font and a clean sans-serif, elevates the brand's heritage in a sophisticated, non-traditional way.
